title: HELP! got MZ for my Chromebook (steam for Chromebook) but..

posts.author: BDAYSTEIN
posts.body:
I just got MZ for my Chromebook and my iMac. (this is my first Rpg maker software.) The iMac functions, but when I select play test, it gives me an error that read something along the lines of; "couldn't manifest file, JSON not supported," or something, which was strange speaking that it said it had Mac support. I'm assuming this is merely because of the apple update, which probably broke a lot of software, but I don't know for sure. Hoping for some insight.
And for the Chromebook, which uses Steam for Chromebooks, (beta) I think how it works is it runs on some type of emulator, and this one works fine, but about 10 seconds after it starts, it shows a still sprite of a white square, it looks like a button or a misplaced sprite but it won't disappear no matter what I try, even showing on my background after I move the window. It's not the worst but extremely inconveinent. Any suggestions? EDIT: forgot to say, but the white square is in the top right-ish corner of the screen.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
Concerning the chromebook, it's unlikely anyone can help you when using the software on unsupported hardware and software. I also believe Steam has already ended support for Chromebook, iirc. It was a short-lived romance.
As for Mac, as I'm not a user so it's hard for me to say personally, but I'm not sure it supports Apple Silicon
Maybe someone can confirm that.
If you downloaded it through steam, it's worth running an file integrity check to make sure everything downloaded and installed properly.
Have you tried googling the error you got? Did anyone else report the same problem? If so did they solve it?
Edit:
Indeed, support pretty much unofficially ended awhile ago, with it officially ending next year.
Google ending Steam for Chromebook support in 2026
After introducing in 2022, Steam for Chromebook will stop working in early 2026. At the time, it was a big effort...
